answer_1.quote: We focus on the task of improving faithfulness through refinement... we evaluate on three summarization datasets with MAMM-REFINE, MediaSum, MeetingBank, and UltraChat, and also on long-form question answering (ELI5) ...
answer_1.outputs: Refined summaries and refined long-form answers

answer_2.quote: We assess the faithfulness of the summaries using MiniCheck and a GPT-4-based Likert evaluation... we also compare to MiniCheck and AlignScore metrics as baselines.

answer_3.quote: We prompt GPT-4o to assess whether the generated critique aligns with the human-written critique... we also use GPT-4 based Likert evaluation to score faithfulness of refined outputs.
methods: Prompt-based pairwise evaluation of critique alignment

answer_4.quote: We also verify this with human evaluations in Section C.1... we assess whether the generated critique aligns with the human-written critique, selecting options such as Error Match, Error No Match, No Error Detected.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters compare generated critiques to human-written critiques and label the correspondence as Error Match, Error No Match, or No Error Detected.
